            name=name.strip()

            if amt_str.startswith('$'):
                amt=float(amt_str.replace('$','').strip())
            else:
                amt=float(amt_str)
            shares[name]+=amt

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# 1) Determine dinner note(s) from simple note with title containing 'Friends Dinner'
simple_note_token = globals()['simple_note_token']

def search_notes_all(query='', sort_by='-updated_at', page_limit=20):
    all=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=sort_by)
        print('search page',page_index,'n',len(resp) if resp else 0)
        if not resp:
            break
        all.extend(resp)
        page_index+=1
    return all

notes = search_notes_all(query='Friends Dinner', sort_by='-updated_at', page_limit=20)
print('total_notes_from_query',len(notes))
# Filter to titles containing 'Friends Dinner' exactly and get created_at
candidates=[]
for n in notes:
    title=n['title']
    if 'Friends Dinner' in title:
        candidates.append(n)
print('candidates_count',len(candidates))
